skins.name: Echo of Bagpipes
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Echo of Bagpipes
skins.description: Clothes Bagpipe wears when she heads home. No need for any fancy accessories. A simple dress and a bright smile are enough to charm even the critters frolicking by her side.

skins.name: Romance Overflow
skins.code: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Romance Overflow
skins.description: Elaborate dress Hibiscus wore to promote a sightseeing train. Brilliant purples, beautiful hem, and delicate ornamentation—a perfect union of elegance and romance.

skins.name: Rose Rider
skins.code: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Rose Rider
skins.description: Outfit Verdant wears when passing along the love of others. A casual and leisurely ensemble. The red jacket and the design on the jeans go well with the festive roses.

skins.name: Frosted Steps
skins.description: Outfit Matoimaru wore when taking part in a period piece. An elegant Higashinese dress combined with delicate makeup bring out her hidden charms in all their glory.

skins.name: Sent from Ognisko
skins.code: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Sent from Ognisko
skins.description: Clothes Viviana wore on a short return trip to Ognisko, a pure linen dress paired with a knitted shawl. With these, she wanders the city of shady trees and the sounds of artisans.

skins.name: The Ferry Girl
skins.code: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/The Ferry Girl
skins.description: Clothes Gloria wears on outings. The pink and white of the dress and the flowers complement each other. This is the ferry to the land of love, and she's waiting for you to board.
